Artist is signed to Warner Music Group with multi-album commitment. Contract buyout would require $20M+ investment, far exceeding Believe's acquisition parameters. This represents an absolute barrier to signing.

**2. Infrastructure Scale Mismatch (CRITICAL)**  
Artist's 13.2M monthly listeners requires global marketing infrastructure, radio promotion teams across 40+ countries, and corporate partnership divisions that exceed Premium Solutions service capacity. Believe's largest comparable signing (Sofia Reyes at 1.5M) operates at 11% of this scale.

Even Premium Solutions revenue-share model becomes economically unfavorable at this scale. Artist likely commands 80%+ net revenue share with major label, plus multi-million dollar advances per album cycle. Believe's typical 50-70% artist share cannot compete.

**4. Between-Cycle Timing Risk (MODERATE)**  
Press coverage focuses on legal/business matters rather than new music, suggesting artist is between album cycles. Monthly listener count may decline 20-30% without active promotion, though this remains irrelevant given signing impossibility.
